name: I.E.S Holdings Ltd
summary: IES Holdings Ltd. primarily engages in the production and marketing of construction products in Israel and internationally. The company operates through Spare and Investment and Real Estate for Rent; and Other segments. It provides pre-cast concrete products for the construction industry. The company is also involved in the rental and leasing of land; development of real estate properties; and establishment of the airpark in the Ovda military base, as well as the natural gas power station in Palmachim Park. It serves construction companies and commercial tenants. The company was formerly known as I.E.S Saar Ltd. and changed its name to IES Holdings Ltd. in February 2005. IES Holdings Ltd. was founded in 1987 and is based in Tel Aviv, Israel.
